items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I can call somebody in there now. Mm-hmm. One of them called Vance on last year. He died some time ago. He was a true cubicle. He was good. Very good.

ctx.x: Well, what about, uh, when you were just a young boy, did they have any brass bands, you know, even before you started playing?
Oh yeah, they had brass bands, yeah. I can call somebody in there now. Mm-hmm. One of them called Vance on last year. He died some time ago. He was a true cubicle. He was good. Very good.
From La Place? Yeah, from La Place.
